Assess and improve all site HR processes and implement a control plan to stabilize them. Support the development and implementation of a comprehensive workforce development strategy. Support efforts to bring new talent into the organization by ensuring a successful candidate experience and an effective selection process. Develop and support strategy for expanding and improving the effectiveness of employee engagement. Partner regularly with HRBP and site leaders to assess and grow the leadership capability of front-line leaders. Partner with talent development specialist and department leaders to assess and grow the leadership capability of front-line leaders. Support development and implementation of plans to positively influence culture of employee engagement and ownership, and ensure significant time in the field to drive improved employee relations.
Coordinate recruitment activities, including working daily with assigned recruiters, posting positions, scheduling, arranging travel, and handling candidate correspondence. Screen hourly applicants and forward qualified candidate resumes to hiring managers. Oversee the onboarding process and conduct orientation for all new hires, connecting with each new employee from day one. Assist with the development and implementation of workforce forecasts and plans, including resourcing and selection activities. Create and implement communication plans that support key business and HR-related initiatives. Partner closely with first-line leaders to establish proactive employee relations, initiating discussions early to resolve issues before they escalate. Provide guidance and accurate interpretation on HR policies, processes, and procedures, walking leaders through decisions and handling questions directly. Analyze compliance requirements, trends, and key metrics, and actively contribute to the broader HR organization to develop and implement solutions, programs, and policies. Partner with HRBP to plan and facilitate training-related activities and events, including material production and distribution, within authorized budgets. Coordinate and maintain HRIS data entry and maintenance activities. Act as Site Culture Team Champion. Perform site responsibilities related to the position of [Company name masked] Cares Site Representative.
Demonstrate personal example in driving [Company name masked]'s zero-incident safety culture through safe work practices and employee engagement. Demonstrate personal example in alignment of site culture to [Company name masked] Values.
Reports to: Human Resources Manager
cond_0060.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources or other Business discipline
3 Years' experience in Human Resources, including a strong employee relations background
Sound knowledge and understanding of employment laws and practices, including FMLA, FLSA, and payroll
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including presentation skills
Customer focused, detail oriented, and strong analytical skills
Ability to positively influence at all levels of the organization
Ability to work effectively in ambiguous situations in a collaborative and inclusive way
Listens actively to others, assimilates their input and views, and relates well to people from varied backgrounds
Demonstrated ability to handle confidential and sensitive matters professionally and discreetly
Works well as part of a team while also able to work independently where needed
Ability to assess and track effectiveness metrics (e.g., Talent Acquisition, training programs, AOP adherence)
Preferred Requirements
Experience with HRIS data systems and applicant tracking systems
Proficiency with Microsoft applications
PHR/SPHR or SHRM CP/SCP certification (or willingness to complete within 18 months)
Experience in a manufacturing environment
Workday experience
Cornerstone Learning Management System (LMS) experience
